lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance circular clusters are arranged in longitudinal rows; density is higher anteriorly with smaller, closer-packed spots, transitioning to larger, more widely spaced spots posteriorly.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Visible vertical bands of increased luminance intersect with the longitudinal spot rows, forming a grid pattern where spots act as nodes within the intersections.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A longitudinal ridge is clearly visible along the upper third of the flank, manifesting as a sharp contrast boundary between illuminated dorsal surface and shadowed ventral surface.

other_distinctive_markers: The pectoral fin features a distinct population of smaller, high-frequency white spots concentrated toward the distal edge.
